title: After changing the OG template, brand geometry, photo or either dataset, run `pnpm run og:local` and commit the regenerated images and og.lock.json
body: The social cards are committed artifacts, not build output (the Cloudflare builder has no Chromium). Their fingerprint in og.lock.json (repo root) hashes the texts derived from content/data/content.es.json and content.en.json, the template scripts/og-template.ts, the brand in src/lib/brand.ts and the photo public/foto.jpeg. Steps: 1) make the change; 2) `pnpm run og:local` (launches Chromium via scripts/build-og.ts); 3) commit public/og.jpg, public/og.en.jpg and og.lock.json together with the change. Otherwise `pnpm run test:og` (scripts/og-output.check.ts) fails as stale — that is the gate working, not a false positive. If the check reports the image is over WhatsApp's weight ceiling, lower `QUALITY` in scripts/build-og.ts rather than switching to PNG.
not_derivable: A dataset edit looks unrelated to the social card; the dependency only appears when test:og fails after a build, and the fix requires committing binaries.

evidence.summary: PHOTO = public/foto.jpeg; fingerprint hashes texts + photo; outputs public/og.jpg and public/og.en.jpg.
og:local writes the images and og.lock.json; QUALITY tuned for WhatsApp's weight ceiling.
test:og: dimensions, weight ceiling, staleness against the fingerprint, favicon vs brand.ts.
